textRun.content: Clang dependency graphs compared with captured CUDA operations
Source analysis and a real Tesla T4 run

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled.
We compare operations after grouping each kernel’s logical reads and writes.
Reads and writes of global buffers
Edges from the same CUDA stream
A kernel read/write node does not prove a separate physical memory transfer.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled.
Each graph exposes a different level of detail.
One API copy can move an entire array. Both graphs show these copies.
Clang combines thread accesses into buffer read/write footprints.
Nsight Systems places those accesses inside a single kernel event.
Neither graph resolves individual cache or DRAM transactions.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled.
One kernel box contains hundreds of accesses
Nearest Neighbor processes 513 records in this capture.
Nsight Systems: 1 euclid event (1 kernel execution)
We combine all threads’ accesses into one read node and one write node per buffer, even though the source tells us which elements each thread accesses.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled. Source: nn_cuda.cu euclid kernel and analysis.json. Each active thread reads one pair of coordinates and writes one float. These are logical element accesses, not physical transaction counts.
513 records, each containing two float32 coordinates
Host uploads coordinates, launches euclid, then downloads distances.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. Kernel expression copied from source, whitespace reformatted.
Nearest Neighbor: Clang and GPU graphs
Clang aggregates thread accesses. Nsight Systems records the whole kernel.
t1 and t2 describe one kernel execution.
Orange - explicit host cop to GPU (movement of data)

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled. Sources: nn_clang_original.json, nn_clang_grouped_dag.json, nn_execution_dag.json. Explicit copy byte counts agree.
HotSpot3D: launch loop and buffer reuse
64 × 64 × 3 cells, two iterations, 49,152 bytes per buffer
nx, ny, nz, ce, cw, cn, cs, ct, cb, cc);
After two swaps, tOut_d holds iteration 1’s output.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled. Source: workloads/rodinia/hotspot3d/opt1.cu, host launch loop. Exact executable statements with line wrapping. Allocations and initial uploads omitted.
Each iteration gets its own read/write footprints. Individual thread accesses are aggregated.
Repeated stencil reads count unique bytes,
not every read instruction. 49,152 B per node.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled. Source: hotspot3d_clang_original.json. Labels A/B denote physical allocations, rather than changing pointer variable values. A initially holds temperature. B holds iteration 1 output. Kernel 2 overwrites A. Power is P. All nodes have 49,152 logical bytes.
Each kernel contains many memory accesses. This trace shows whole operations.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled. Source: hotspot3d_execution_dag.json. The trace gives copy directions, but naming uploads temperature and power uses source order.
Execution order and data dependency differ
The final HotSpot3D download illustrates why both graphs matter.
Source identifies B as the downloaded buffer. The trace alone cannot verify its identity.

Capture: 20261027T033003Z, Tesla T4. Source revision 4106565d567f39851e0371ab07a4efdeaf3fd3d2. Sources: results/rodinia_trace_comparison/comparison.json and execution_dag JSON files. One profiled run per workload. Synthetic input data. Diagrams are schematic, not time-scaled. Source: hotspot3d_clang_grouped_dag.json edges include 2→4 and exclude 3→4. GPU stream chain includes 3→4. Full grouped source DAG also includes uploads and reuse dependencies. Diagram shows only the kernel/download portion. Trace virtualAddress fields are null, so buffer identity comes from source.
Both workloads match the expected operation structure.
Use Clang for buffer dependencies and the trace for measured execution order and timing.
